static_traits.family_status: Living in a city, Not mentioned specific family members
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends but not yet opening up about Anxiety with them; finding it hard to discuss these thoughts with classmates or professors

basic_info.main_problem: Constantly weighed down by the thought 'I will never graduate from university and become a Nurse', these thoughts stronger during exams or challenging assignments, affecting motivation, confidence, and sleep and diet.
basic_info.core_demands: These increasingly strong thoughts seriously affect my motivation and mental health, hence seeking counseling for support; hoping to find ways to get past these thoughts and feel more confident about the future.
growth_experiences: Before a pharmacology exam, I was very Fearful and worried about failing, but finally passed with a decent grade. Even so, when feeling Anxious again, these success experiences are hard to recall, and I keep worrying about the next exam or assignment performance.

special_situations.event: As important exams or deadlines approach
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly in exams, it proves I am not good enough, leading to inability to graduate and realize career goals
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling studying and seeking academic support; trying to ignore these thoughts and push through to complete tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail the exam, never graduate, and never become a Nurse

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete hard tasks well, it means I am unqualified and doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works overtime studying, reduces discussing with others to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will surely fail; this proves I am not suited for nursing

special_situations.event: After achieving good grades, still faces subsequent exams or assignments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Past successes do not count; next time will be harder and I may fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence, continuing to worry and engage in Self-denial
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time was just luck, next time I will still fail

core_conflict.wish: Longing for achievement and recognition (graduating smoothly, becoming a Nurse)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and negation, worrying about being unable to realize self-worth
defense_goal: Suppressing Anxiety and maintaining control (through hard Learning and ignoring negative thoughts)
Avoids exposing vulnerability lest others judge (reduces discussing inner worries with classmates or professors)

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Student, a likely failure
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh critic (exams and courses as high thresholds)

manifestations: Hard to discuss inner failure worries and Anxiety with peers or professors
Having friends but not yet opening up about these thoughts with them

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses originally meant for outward expression or gives up seeking others' help outwardly, instead turning energy inward toward oneself (recycling outward-bound energy back to the self).
manifestations: Not expressing worries to friends or professors, choosing to bear pressure alone
Trying to tough it out and ignore thoughts during strong Anxiety, rather than seeking external support

exception_events.target_problem: Before an important exam, the client is usually trapped by catastrophic and failure-predicting thoughts, with strong Anxiety and Self-doubt, leading to Decreased attention, Sleep and eating disrupted, Learning efficiency impaired.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a pharmacology exam, despite great prior Fear, the client was not completely trapped by Anxiety, but completed the exam and passed with a decent grade.
exception_events.reason: Different actions: did systematic review and sought academic support; different understanding: realizing most courses already passed, with success experiences, these cues played a role in that exam.

positive_force: Already has successful experience of passing most courses with high scores in single subjects
Willing to seek academic support and study twice as hard
Open and cooperative toward counseling, willing to practice thought restructuring and positive visualization
negative_force: Catastrophizing and failure-predicting cognitive patterns prominent
Core Self-denial belief ('I am not good enough')
Anxiety worsened before exams and deadlines, causing Sleep and diet disturbance and Learning Decreased efficiency
Hard to express to others and seek support, tends to bear pressure alone

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic and failure-predicting thinking when Approaching exams or deadlines, with Significant anxiety and Self-denial, affecting focus and Learning behavior
target_behavior.core_reason: Deep self-evaluation as 'I am not good enough', inferring overall failure from single performance, forming catastrophic predictions of never graduating and never becoming a Nurse
target_behavior.function: Escaping Fear of failure, trying to drive more preparation through Anxiety to gain control
target_behavior.consequence: Learning Decreased drive and occasional 'paralysis', impaired attention and efficiency; sleep and diet disrupted; Social interaction affected; academic progress may stall
